quotes.text: const position = getIdealDialogPosition({ trigger, container, dialog });

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The unit task destructures trigger, container, dialog and result from each fixture, passes only the three input fields to getIdealDialogPosition, and compares x/y afterward. Review requests this so returning an input result field cannot satisfy the test. The browser helper can receive the full fixture because it unpacks inputs before exercising the dialog; the two boundaries differ. This is a test-design lesson, not a claim those many fixtures cover every geometry case. No test ran.
title: Pure geometry tests keep the expected result outside the function input
